author.name: Andrea Leigh Hayes
author.heading: Hello, I’m Andrea.
author.descriptor: Storyteller. Music lover. Champion of little imaginations.
bioParagraphs: Andrea Leigh Hayes has dedicated her career to inspiring and educating children, bringing creativity and joy from the stage to the classroom.
After earning a BA (Hons) in Musical Theatre, singing and music remained at the heart of everything she does, shaping the rhythmic and engaging way she connects with young minds.

Having spent most of her life in the United Arab Emirates, Andrea was inspired to write her debut children’s book to celebrate the rich beauty of the country she calls home and to share the timeless message of unity and the power of the Union with a new generation of readers.

book.title: Bumbleboo discovers the UAE
book.author: Andrea Leigh Hayes
book.shortDescription: A joyful journey across all seven emirates about friendship, discovery and unity.
blurbParagraphs: Oh no! The colours of the UAE flag have gone missing!

When a colourful caterpillar asks Bumbleboo for help, the little bee takes to the sky on a quest across all seven emirates. From flamingos in the mangroves of Umm Al Quwain to dancing fountains in Dubai, Bumbleboo meets new friends and follows clues through mountains, deserts and sparkling seas.
Can you spot the missing colours before Bumbleboo does?

faqs.question: What is Bumbleboo’s adventure about?
faqs.answer: When the colours of the UAE flag go missing, Bumbleboo sets off on a quest across all seven emirates. Along the way, the little bee meets new friends and discovers the beauty of friendship, curiosity and unity.
